description: Main Scala source file for a TodoMVC application using binding-scala library, implementing a to-do list with local storage, reactive UI components, and event handling.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: Class representing a to-do item with a title and completion status.

classes.name: TodoList
classes.description: Class representing a list of to-dos with display text, URL hash, and items.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads to-do items from local storage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves to-do items to local storage.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Creates the header UI component with input for new to-dos.

methods.name: todoListItem
methods.description: Creates a UI component for a single to-do item with editing and toggling.

methods.name: mainSection
methods.description: Creates the main section UI with toggle all and list of to-dos.

methods.name: footer
methods.description: Creates the footer UI with filters and clear completed button.

methods.name: todoapp
methods.description: Assembles the entire to-do application UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to render the to-do app into the DOM container.
